newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian evangelist cuts off husband's penis.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian evangelist cuts off husband's penis.

text.p: A Brazilian evangelist fed up with her husband's habitual weekend smoking and drinking cut off most of his penis with a kitchen knife after a heated argument, police said on Tuesday.

Glassmaker Silas Leite da Silva called for an ambulance after his wife, Neide Maria Begalli, cut off 90 percent of his penis while he slept in bed, according to police in the city of Campinas, 60 miles (100 km) northwest of Sao Paulo.
Da Silva's penis was reattached after the attack on Monday and he was expected to make a full recovery, police said.
His wife fled after the incident, but was later caught and admitted to a hospital psychiatric ward.

News reports quoted neighbours as saying Da Silva was a calm man who drank heavily on the weekends. They said he frequently sneaked cigarettes, a habit which infuriated his wife who forbade him from smoking in their home.
